source: Published OpenAI API pricing, checked 2026-07-31 (developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5-nano and corroborating price trackers).
note: Costs charged to the global ledger are computed from the token counts the provider returns, never from a flat per-call figure. Cached-input discounts are deliberately NOT assumed: pricing every input token at the full rate makes the ledger conservative.
fallback_policy: A model absent from this manifest cannot be priced, so the provider refuses to run rather than silently charging an invented rate.
